summary: ArcelorMittal filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release on publication of third-quarter 2026 sell-side analyst consensus figures, compiled by Visible Alpha from 12 brokers as of October 30, 2026. Consensus 3Q26 EBITDA is $1,972m, adjusted net income $652m and adjusted EPS $0.84, the latter pair excluding anticipated non-cash charges tied to the previously announced idling of ArcelorMittal Kryvyi Rih in Ukraine. No transaction, capital-structure event or board recommendation is involved; four analysts lacking updated Ukraine impairment estimates were excluded. This is a routine earnings-consensus disclosure, with the key watch item being whether reported 3Q26 results, and Ukraine impairment treatment, converge on these estimates.
